questions.prompt: What is the big idea of How a Flowering Plant Grows?
choices: Flowering plants grow from seeds and make new seeds.
Only a shoot reaches light and opens its first leaves.
Only flowers can attract animals that transfer pollen.
questions.answer: Flowering plants grow from seeds and make new seeds.
questions.rationale: Many flowering plants begin as seeds containing embryos and food stores. A shoot reaches light and opens its first leaves. With suitable conditions a new flowering-plant cycle can begin. Together, these facts show the whole-book big idea: Flowering plants grow from seeds and make new seeds.
